_source: Lesson text pieces of whole documents, first written by hand from egatari-spec subset-parse c6024bf and checked against the reference producer: egatari/components tools/subset-produce.mjs htmlPieces at c004416 (components c2-base; same code as 0a5be1b) (parse5 8.0.1). Regenerate only from that reference.

cases.name: duplicate attributes: only the first, the one the parser keeps
tree order: an element's attribute values before its children
<plaintext>: the rest of the source is one text node, not decoded
SVG CDATA: its contents are text, not decoded
CDATA outside foreign content is a bogus comment
<textarea> (RCDATA): decoded, tags are text, a leading newline dropped
<noscript> with scripting enabled (RAWTEXT): one text node, not decoded
<style> in SVG and non-JSON <script> do not count; a JSON <script> is read as JSON (type trimmed, any case)
CR and CRLF are LF; references decoded
